name: A Job for Each
jem_summary: Complete a real Barrel Golem exchange or collect Honey Golem honey, and station a Hay Golem by crops.

pages.title: A Job for Each
pages.text: Complete a real Barrel Golem exchange or collect Honey Golem honey, and station a Hay Golem by crops.

pages.title: A Job for Each
pages.text: Statues open the next construct-helper route and honey remains useful after the first genuine result.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Drop the allowed payment near a Barrel Golem; Honey Golems occur in birch forests. Hay Golems protect nearby crops from trampling. Server economy may change payments; planks are not a trade.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Build or find a Hay Golem and keep it near farmland. Nearby crops receive protection from trampling.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Drop emeralds near a Barrel Golem found in a village. The golem exchanges them through its own loot table.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Find a Honey Golem in a birch forest and collect its honey blobs. Its resident bees support the golem and produce throwable honey resources.
